name: Davidson Fabricating, Inc.
description: Davidson Fabricating cuts, welds, and delivers structural work for jobs that cannot guess. Call when the drawings are ready.

hero.headline: Steel that holds the building up
hero.sub: Davidson Fabricating cuts, welds, and delivers structural work for jobs that cannot guess. Call when the drawings are ready.

story.heading: A shop that reads the print
paragraphs: We fabricate what the job needs, not a catalog page. Send the drawings. We will tell you what we can run and when.
Contractors come back because the pieces fit and the phone gets answered.
Davidson Fabricating, Inc. serves people who live and work in Chester County.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

items: Walk the shop if you need to
Get a date you can plan around
experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: Fabrication you can schedule
feature.text: Lead times stay honest. If a piece will slip, you hear it from us before the job feels it.

spotlight.heading: 11 Hagerty Boulevard
spotlight.text: The West Chester shop is where the work happens. Come by when you want to see the floor, not a brochure.

contact.heading: Talk to the shop
contact.sub: Call with the job name and what you need fabricated. We will take it from there.
